dependencies.scope: Validates NUN image metadata and memory handoff prerequisites; does not boot, authenticate, or execute the image.

boundaries: Image validation is pre-handoff only and never executes image code.
SHA-256 comparison is not publisher authentication or a digital signature.
Secure Boot, TPM attestation, key rotation, and physical-device qualification are not claimed.
Unknown architecture or unsupported metadata fails closed.

verification.host_tests: Run CMake/CTest, make test, and Python unittest discovery.
verification.target_validation: QEMU validation is separate from physical firmware and hardware qualification.
